meta.title: DSH Toolbox
meta.description: Personal tool pack: single-store memory injection + memory write tool (the store root holds machine-shared entries, machines/<machine>/ holds machine-private ones), see_image (vision model transcription via host LLM channel), dispatch_plan/review/build/verify (the dispatcher split into four tools, each serving one fixed stage — 方案/门一/施工/门二; they assemble review-form combos and ready-made briefs per batch type, and the plan one emits the plan task book; rules live in JSON read fresh on every call; one exception: the enum in the parameter surface is a registration-time snapshot, so a new legal value needs a restart to enter that vocabulary), dispatch_batch (batch ledger with start/advance/status/list; state is folded from the events, the ledger lives in the machine-shared agent-data repo, and the four assembler tools back-fill that batch's decision list when given batch=), dispatch_lessons (retro helper: covers only the batches with events after the last retrospective event, in-flight batches included, and drafts pairing-rule revision suggestions once enough batches are covered — suggestions only, the main session decides and nothing is written back), and usage_note (usage-log note hatch: the recorder listens on host tool-call events and appends this pack's nine tools as a per-day jsonl under <DSH home>/toolbox-usage/ — argument/result summaries and error.info on failures included, machine-private; hidden snags that structured fields cannot hold get a note/tool/ok line, sharing one timeline with the call lines at retro time).
